shots.visual: A bullet sparks against a metal pillar inches from his face, debris flying across his cheek.
Holding a blood-stained folder, laughing maniacally with a twisted expression of triumph.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 你以為你掌控了一切？你不過是個可憐蟲！

shots.visual: Eyes narrowing, breathing heavily, gun still aimed but body tense in cover.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 少廢話，今天誰也救不了你。

shots.visual: Throwing the folder onto a table, the documents scattering everywhere.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 看看這些！當年害你入獄的主謀，是你親弟弟！

shots.visual: Pupils dilating in shock, the reflection of the documents visible in his eyes.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 不可能……他在五年前就失蹤了！

shots.visual: Leaning forward, his face obscured by shadows, whispering like a demon.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 是他親手把罪證交給我，換取了去海外的機票。

shots.visual: Clutching her wounded arm, looking at the documents on the floor with doubt.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 陳總，別聽他的！他在動搖你的心智！

shots.visual: Smirking, pointing at a signature on one of the papers.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 這筆跡，你應該比我更熟悉吧？

shots.visual: Memories flash by in a blur, sweating, the gun hand slightly trembling.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 為了錢……他竟然連親哥哥都賣？

shots.visual: Spreading arms wide, the silhouette of a sniper visible through the window behind him.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 親情在利益面前，一文不值！

shots.visual: Suddenly regaining focus, his expression turning cold and sharp again.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 不，你在撒謊。我弟弟根本不抽菸。

shots.visual: Pointing at a yellow stain on the document page with his boot.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 這份文件上有尼古丁的味道，是你偽造的！

shots.visual: His smile freezing, facial muscles twitching in anger.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 死到臨頭，還在嘴硬！

shots.visual: Pulling out a small tablet, data scrolling rapidly on screen.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 陳總，我查到了，狙擊手在三點鐘方向！

shots.visual: Diving behind a heavy wooden table as another shot shatters the glass above him.
Standing up, kicking a chair away, looking desperate.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 你以為發現真相就能活著出去？

shots.visual: Checking his magazine, only three bullets left. A grim smile appears.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 殺你，一顆子彈就夠了。

shots.visual: Backing away slowly toward a hidden compartment in the wall.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳峰，你太小看趙家的底蘊了。

shots.visual: Looking around the room, noticing red blinking lights under the floorboards.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 陳總！這地方埋了炸藥！

shots.visual: The entire room is revealed to be a death trap, sensors glowing in the dark corners.
Pulling out a small, black remote with a single red button.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 既然我得不到，那就全部毀掉！

shots.visual: Veins popping on his forehead, aiming the gun with absolute precision.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 放下它，你還有機會坐牢。

shots.visual: Sweat dripping down his nose, eyes wide and bloodshot.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 坐牢？我寧願拉你一起下地獄！

shots.visual: Struggling to stand, reaching for a tactical knife on her belt.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 快阻止他！

shots.visual: The sniper's laser dot moves onto Chen Feng's heart.
Lifting the remote high in the air, thumb hovering over the trigger.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳峰，永別了！

shots.visual: A look of sudden calm, as if he expected this move all along.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你真的以為，我是一個人來的？

shots.visual: A moment of confusion crosses his face before turning back to rage.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 故弄玄虛！去死吧！

shots.visual: Slow motion: His thumb begins to press down on the red button.
Sprinting toward Zhao Tianhao, ignoring the sniper threat.
Closing her eyes, bracing for the impact of the explosion.
The button is fully depressed. A mechanical 'click' sound is heard.
A tense silence hangs in the air. No explosion occurs.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 怎麼可能……為什麼沒炸！

shots.visual: Now standing directly in front of Zhao, his shadow looming over him.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 因為這份大禮，我五分鐘前就收下了。

shots.visual: His face pale as a ghost, staring at the useless remote in horror as the screen fades to black.
